text:
No option can be put forward: the **£400k/year salary limit was not checked** in this model.

- The comparison is **fragile** and the options produced almost identical model outcomes, so the apparent differences are not reliable enough to settle the hiring choice.
- The result is most sensitive to **delivery capacity**, an Olumi estimate rather than user evidence; the model also relies on six machine-supplied values.
- The goal direction was not stated, so the analysis assumed that a higher modelled “new platform delivery by Q3” value is better.
